# intenter history show

Explain one decision in full

Prints everything recorded for one event: the raw command and how it was
resolved (wrappers, scripts, the final commands), every target with its scope,
the effects, the fingerprints read, the hard-rule and approval outcome, what
the agent was told, and — for an approval that stopped matching — exactly what
changed. The event id is printed by the hook message and by `intenter history`.

## Usage

```text
intenter history show <event-id>
```

## Examples

```console
intenter history show 42
intenter history show 42 --json
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `<string>` | — | override the configuration file path |
| `--data-dir` `<string>` | — | override the Intenter data directory |
| `--json` | — | machine-readable JSON output |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | — | verbose output |
